evidence_summary: Recomputed citation heritage (8 reps, 1020 pairs each): all FAIL AUC>0.6 & recall@10>0.2 (best: full_text AUC=0.897, recall@10=0.053). Nesting defect confirmed (max 0.663). No leakage/gaming detected. Negative results honestly reported.
